owner_approval.channel: Claude Code session 3cf5f3a5-3285-4fbd-9cf1-16e43f5458c5, decision menus of 2026-08-29
owner_approval.content: the owner approved the Codex-ratified replay_divergence disposition as part of the funded finish, then re-approved it within the corrected clean-re-run plan after the orchestrator disclosed that the disposition requires an execution-code change forcing a fresh identity

disposition.mechanical_predicate: a cell whose re-execution raises CallReplayMismatch: a cached call row for the cell (identified by call identity: cell_key, call_role, slot, attempt) whose request_sha256 differs from the deterministic recomposition, where the divergence provenance is an earlier same-cell provider call that was refused memoization (truncated/empty) and re-dispatched non-deterministically after a relaunch. Evidence bound per record: the mismatching cached row's cache sequence and request_sha256, the divergent fresh row's cache sequence, and the unmemoized originating ledger sequences. No semantic or treatment-result judgment enters the predicate.
rules: disposal only after ACTUAL divergence (CallReplayMismatch raised); at-risk cells are never preemptively discarded
the whole mirror unit leaves the paired analyses, exactly as amendment 5 disposes checker_malformed units
no imputation, no pass/reject classification, and no reuse of any mismatched cached response

the amendment-5 bounds are CUMULATIVE across all terminal reasons: >20 unique terminal cells, >4% affected mirror units, or concentration (>=5 cells in a judge/condition at >2% or 3x complement) stops the run for owner review and is never relaxable mid-run
if the cumulative bound is exceeded, the completion gate FAILS; no further amendment may raise the bound
no repeated replay attempts intended to obtain a response version that happens to match the cache (retry-shopping is forbidden)
the audit reports exact terminal counts by condition and arm, disclosing that truncation propensity makes the missingness partly content-correlated
the converged result is described as terminally RESOLVED rows, never observed rows; the valid-observation count is reported separately
disposition.codex_distinction: ratified as an integrity disposition, not the previously rejected verdict-truncation exemption: replay_divergence identifies a unit with an internally inconsistent provenance graph where no valid observation exists to classify; the guard proves invalidity without proving the missingness ignorable, which is why the full amendment-5 bounds and disclosures apply

cost_checkpoints.purpose: outcome-blind operational checkpoints so the b4/b8 estimate error cannot compound silently again
cost_checkpoints.content: cumulative in-ledger spend and a revised bottom-up finish forecast, logged to the archive; checkpoints never alter inclusion, analysis, or condition ordering; the authorized ceiling remains the only administrative stop rule

non_claims: This amendment authorizes no provider call and changes no analysis gate, bound value, roster, or budget.
It adds one mechanically-gated terminal reason under the existing amendment-5 machinery and bounds.
